blocks.html: Picture a kirana shop owner in Muzaffarpur with a thick register. Each line has an item, its quantity, its rate and the amount. At the end of the day he adds up every page, and if one rate was written wrongly, he must redo the sums. A spreadsheet is an electronic register that does all the arithmetic for him and redoes it instantly whenever a number changes.
Definition: A spreadsheet is application software that stores data in a grid of rows and columns and can calculate, analyse, sort, filter and chart that data automatically.
Popular spreadsheet programs: Microsoft Excel, LibreOffice Calc (free and open- source), Google Sheets (online, free), Apple Numbers.

items.html: Automatic calculation — change a value and all totals update.
Accuracy — formulas do not make arithmetic mistakes.
Speed — thousands of rows can be sorted or totalled in a second.
Charts — numbers can be turned into graphs with a few clicks.
Easy correction and copying — no rubbing or rewriting.
Storage and sharing — files can be saved, emailed and printed.

blocks.html: Did you know? The first spreadsheet program for personal computers, VisiCalc, was released in 1979. Microsoft Excel first appeared in 1985 for the Apple Macintosh and in 1987 for Windows.

items.html: Insert a row or column: right-click the row number or column letter → Insert. A row is inserted above; a column is inserted to the left.
Delete: right-click → Delete.
Change width or height: drag the border between headings, or double-click it to AutoFit the content.
Hide / Unhide: right-click the heading → Hide; select the neighbours → Unhide.
Insert a worksheet: click + or press Shift + F11.
Rename: double-click the sheet tab and type a new name, e.g. Term 1.
Delete, move, copy, colour tab: right-click the sheet tab.

A spreadsheet stores data in rows and columns and calculates automatically. Excel, Calc and Google Sheets are examples.
The Excel window has a title bar, Quick Access Toolbar, ribbon, Name Box, Formula Bar, row and column headings, cells, sheet tabs and status bar.
A workbook contains worksheets; a cell is addressed by column letter and row number; a range is written as first:last.
Text is left-aligned and numbers right-aligned by default; formulas start with =.
AutoFill continues series; Flash Fill copies a pattern (Ctrl + E).
Rows, columns and sheets can be inserted, deleted, resized, hidden and renamed.
Workbooks are usually saved as .xlsx; .csv keeps plain data only.
